selection_rule: 4 per hidden family by FNV-1a(seed|blind_id); family labels omitted from evaluator input

cases.title: Sanitarium
facts: story-led point-and-click adventure with psychologically surreal settings
puzzles are integrated into narrative and atmosphere
pixel hunting, mazes and some unclear interactions can create friction

cases.title: The Banner Saga 2
facts: turn-based tactical combat emphasizes positioning, armor/health tradeoffs and unit abilities
strategic caravan decisions feed narrative consequences
refines the first game's systems but is narratively dependent on prior context

cases.title: Resident Evil 4
facts: third-person horror-action with deliberately paced shooting
frequent set-pieces/bosses and clear forward direction maintain momentum
long adventure includes secrets and bonus content, with sustained action variety

cases.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion
facts: large open-ended RPG with extensive character customization and exploration
many guilds, side quests and activities support different play styles
quest tracking gives clear goals despite the world's breadth

cases.title: Marvel's Spider-Man
facts: web-swinging traversal has an accessible but expressive movement system
acrobatic combat expands through skills/gadgets and supports some stealth
story and superhero identity are prominent while recurring city crimes/activities repeat

cases.title: Mafia II
facts: story-led crime action with a detailed city
strong narrative/action focus
open city is underused and offers little meaningful side content

cases.title: WarCraft 3: The Frozen Throne
facts: expansion adds multiple campaigns, units, heroes and substantial mechanical depth
campaign missions deliberately vary objectives and often depart from standard base-building
bonus campaign shifts toward hero-led RPG-like exploration

cases.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone
facts: compact story-focused expansion built around character-rich branching quests
story subverts expectations and uses varied combat/non-combat quest situations
some minigame/detective passages interrupt pacing
